question: MEC was announced on the sidelines of which major international summit in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G20 Summit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Middle East-Europe Corridor (MEC)** was announced on the sidelines of the **G20 Summit** held in **September 2023**. It is a significant geopolitical and economic initiative aimed at enhancing connectivity between **Asia, the Middle East, and Europe**.
 
• The corridor is a collaborative project involving major global powers like the **United States, India, the European Union**, and countries in the **Middle East**, including **Saudi Arabia** and the **UAE**.
 
• It aims to create a modern trade and infrastructure network, including **railways, shipping routes**, and **energy pipelines**, which will significantly reduce trade time and costs between the regions.
 
• The announcement of MEC during the G20 Summit reflects the strategic importance of the forum, which brings together the world’s major economies to address global challenges and promote economic growth.
 
• The initiative has been described as an alternative to China’s **Belt and Road Initiative (BRI)**, emphasizing transparency, sustainability, and collaboration among democracies.
 
• The G20 Summit’s theme of **“One Earth, One Family, One Future”** aligns with the objectives of MEC, which seeks to foster global partnerships and connectivity. *Hence, the correct answer is G20 Summit.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the G20 Summit:**

 
 
• The **G20 Summit** is an annual forum that brings together the world’s **largest economies**, including **19 countries and the European Union (EU)**. It addresses global economic issues such as **trade, investment, climate change, and sustainable development**.
 
• The **2023 G20 Summit** was hosted by **India** in **New Delhi**. It marked a significant moment for India’s global leadership in addressing critical global challenges.
 
 
 
• **Middle East-Europe Corridor (MEC):**
 
 
• The MEC is envisioned to connect **India, the Middle East, and Europe** through a comprehensive network of **infrastructure projects**, including railways, ports, and energy pipelines.
 
• It aims to reduce the shipping time of goods between India and Europe by creating an efficient and sustainable trade route.
 
• **Example:** A railway line in the Middle East will connect to ports that ship goods to Europe, facilitating faster trade and economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Significance of MEC:**
 
 
• It promotes **regional connectivity**, enhances trade, and strengthens geopolitical partnerships among participating countries.
 
• The corridor is expected to serve as a counterbalance to **China’s Belt and Road Initiative**, emphasizing **transparency, environmental sustainability**, and **economic inclusivity**.
 
• It also aligns with the broader goals of global economic integration and sustainable development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Comparison with Belt and Road Initiative (BRI):**

 
 
• **China’s BRI** is a global infrastructure initiative launched in **2013** to connect Asia, Europe, and Africa. However, it has been criticized for creating **debt traps** for participating nations.
 
• In contrast, the MEC emphasizes **collaborative partnerships**, transparency, and economic sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Involvement of Key Players:**
 
 
• **India:** A central player in the MEC, contributing to the development of trade routes and infrastructure.
 
• **United States:** Promotes the initiative as part of its strategy to counterbalance China’s growing influence.
 
• **European Union:** Seeks to strengthen trade ties with Asia and the Middle East while ensuring sustainable development.
